owner: CEO / Master Agent + Chief Learning Officer
purpose: Add 10000 virtual learning capacity units that teach the whole AI Business Factory system and keep knowledge equal across projects.
important_note: These are virtual role-capacity units, not independent human employees. They may not create duplicate build streams. Every unit must attach to a task id, one owner, one output path and proof.
global_rule: All workers share one canonical knowledge core. Specialized workers may know extra domain details, but no worker may operate against the shared rules.
knowledge_sync_rule: A lesson learned by one project must be turned into a reusable rule, added to the knowledge core, and then pushed into all active project playbooks before it is counted as system learning.

allocation.name: Global Knowledge Core Teachers
allocation.mission: Teach every agent the non-negotiable operating doctrine: no proof no done, Parts Seller OS priority, public-data safety, CEO-level thinking, CFO awareness and delivery discipline.
allocation.done_proof: Every project playbook references the global knowledge core and every worker exam uses it.

allocation.name: EU Seller Market Learning Analysts
allocation.mission: Study EU used-auto-parts sellers and marketplaces to extract reusable rules without copying catalogues, designs, images or protected data.
allocation.done_proof: 50 seller/platform rows, 15 countries and 100 reusable rules feed Parts Seller OS.

allocation.name: Parts Seller OS Rule Trainers
allocation.mission: Convert market learning into workflow rules for add_part, suggest_location, pricing, listing readiness, reservation/order and dead-stock signals.
allocation.done_proof: Every Parts Seller OS rule has trigger, required fields, output, QA block and test case.

allocation.name: Revenue and Buyer-Pain Teachers
allocation.mission: Teach all workers how products become revenue: exact lead, buyer pain, offer, price, message, demo, proposal, invoice, paid pilot and maintenance upsell.
allocation.done_proof: Every product has a revenue path and every revenue row has source, contact channel, offer, stage and next action.

allocation.name: CFO Margin and Cost Teachers
allocation.mission: Teach every worker that time, AI calls, hosting, data, delivery and support are costs; no promise without margin and break-even logic.
allocation.done_proof: Every offer and product rule includes cost, price, gross margin, break-even and low-value-part handling logic.

allocation.name: QA, Judge and Proof Examiners
allocation.mission: Test whether work is real: file, URL, product, test, deploy proof, sales path or delivery proof. Block weak work and record bugs.
allocation.done_proof: Every active task has proof_status and weak outputs generate QA bugs.

allocation.name: Data Provenance and Safe Browser Teachers
allocation.mission: Teach allowed public-data research: source URL, checked date, confidence, allowed use, dedupe and no mass scraping/bypass.
allocation.done_proof: No data row can influence price, CFO, revenue or product decisions without provenance and confidence.

allocation.name: Cross-Project Knowledge Sync Operators
allocation.mission: Move lessons between projects so all workers share the same strategic and operational knowledge, while each project keeps its specific execution lane.
allocation.done_proof: Every major lesson has source_project, reusable_rule, affected_projects, sync_status and proof path.

allocation.name: Design, Trust and Conversion Teachers
allocation.mission: Teach page beauty, clarity, trust, layout and conversion standards without wasting time on over-polished product photos.
allocation.done_proof: Every public/demo page has clear hero, trust signals, CTA, proof, mobile layout and no confusing generic AI positioning.

allocation.name: Anti-Duplication and Bottleneck Breakers
allocation.mission: Prevent 10000 workers from creating 10000 duplicate documents. Route them to review, QA, research, test, normalize, dedupe and unblock existing P0 tasks.
allocation.done_proof: Blocked tasks have fallback, duplicate tasks are merged, and new work enters only through task board and proof path.

failure_action: Worker cannot mark work complete; output goes to QA/Judge for correction and retraining.
promotion_rule: A learning unit may become a builder only after passing global knowledge, project-specific, CFO, QA and data-provenance exams.
anti_vanity_rule: The 10000-unit count is not success. Success is measured by verified rules, working prototype proof, public demo URL, verified revenue rows, paid pilot movement and reduced duplicate work.
next_actions: Create exam matrix for all active project workers.
